label: copy phase, early recall steps, strongest when copying input s
explanation: Fires mostly in the copy phase (89% of mass), concentrated on the first few recall steps (recall_idx 1-3 hold ~75% of mass), with the very top activations on step L+1 when the fed-back input is s (i.e. sequences starting with s). Input s has 11x lift but s-in-copy-phase only gets F1 0.25 / mass recall 0.31; many activations occur on other tokens (j, r, v, 3, <DEL>) and many early-copy s inputs are silent. Rarely fires in the original phase (never at t=0). No simple predicate over current/previous tokens, position or length captures it.
